items.why: Extending last week's AI rally after a reported custom Iris AI chip push and a BofA Buy reiteration. Shares topped the 200-day moving average for the first time in two months.
Melius Research upgraded to Buy with a $665 target, calling Microsoft the trusted AI security play as AI safety fears send enterprises its way.
Follow-through from the Q3 deliveries beat, with deliveries over 486,000 against a roughly 462,000 consensus. Investors now look to the Roadster reveal and October earnings.
WTI sliding as Iran sets conditions to reopen Hormuz and crude swings lower, per the morning tape.

market_note: Mixed open: S&P and Nasdaq higher, Dow lower, 10Y near 5.31%, bitcoin above $86k.
summary: Tech leads a mixed Monday open with AI names running. S&P futures and the Nasdaq are up while the Dow slips, as bond yields tick toward new highs and oil swings lower.
